article_title: Processing of the national identification number

test_cases.question: Which identifiers may Member States lay down specific processing conditions for?
test_cases.answer: Article 87 covers: (1) national identification numbers, and (2) any other identifier of general application. These are identifiers broadly used to identify individuals within a Member State, not limited to specific sectors or purposes.
test_cases.supporting_quote: the processing of a national identification number or any other identifier of general application

test_cases.question: Can Member States set their own rules for processing national identification numbers?
test_cases.answer: Yes. Member States may further determine the specific conditions for the processing of a national identification number or any other identifier of general application. This allows countries to add their own requirements on top of the GDPR framework.
test_cases.supporting_quote: Member States may further determine the specific conditions for the processing of a national identification number or any other identifier of general application

test_cases.question: What safeguards are required when Member States set conditions for processing national ID numbers?
test_cases.answer: When Member States have determined specific conditions for processing, the national identification number or any other identifier of general application shall be used only under appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of the data subject pursuant to this Regulation.
test_cases.supporting_quote: In that case the national identification number or any other identifier of general application shall be used only under appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of the data subject pursuant to this Regulation
key_phrases: rights and freedoms of the data subject

coverage.87_identifiers: Test case 1 - National ID number + other identifiers of general application
coverage.87_ms_power: Test case 2 - Member States may determine specific conditions
coverage.87_safeguards: Test case 3 - Appropriate safeguards required when MS sets conditions

b2b_relevance: MEDIUM - Article 87 affects B2B SaaS if you process national ID numbers (e.g., SSNs, tax IDs, national insurance numbers). Key points: (1) Check each Member State's specific rules, (2) Must implement appropriate safeguards, (3) Rules vary significantly by country. Relevant for KYC processes, employee onboarding, or any SaaS collecting government-issued identifiers.
